messages:
marta_cs: Weekly health sync — quick check on ACME onboarding. Noticed a jump in 5xx and request timeouts this morning between 09:10-09:40 UTC. Also some rate-limit (429) bursts on /v1/generate. Attaching quick counts and top failing endpoints. Anyone seeing correlating deploys or infra noise? :thinking:

aj_dev: digging in. Top errors (last 30m) by endpoint:
```
/compute/generate  5xx=82  timeout=41  429=5
/api/chat           5xx=12  timeout=8   429=18
/v1/embed           5xx=3   timeout=2   429=0
```
Looks like /compute/generate is the main hotspot (high 5xx + timeouts).

ryan_sre: I see KV cache saturation alerts around 09:12-09:25 in eu-west-1. DB connection pool errors spiking, retries accumulating -> upstream 502s. Also elevated redis evictions and blocked clients.

sam_eng: FYI I rolled a batching config at 08:55 that reduced per-batch size on GPU pools. Saw some warn-level traces but no immediate errors in canary. Could interact poorly with longer sequences.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy succeeded for runtime v1.14 at 08:55 by @sam_eng — 4/4 nodes healthy.

marta_cs: Ok — proposed action items:
1) ryan_sre: confirm whether redis/db is the root cause and attempt immediate remediation (restart/recover)
2) aj_dev: apply short-term routing fallback for critical customers to a lighter model variant to reduce pressure
3) sam_eng: stand by to rollback the batching change or patch batch-handling logic if needed
Can we get ETAs? :clock1:

ryan_sre: kicking KV process restart in eu-west-1 now, will also bump DB pool size temporarily. Monitoring dashboards; ETA ~10m to observe error-rate change.

aj_dev: adding a 10m route override for acme-prod -> model-embed-lite (low-cost variant) to reduce load.

sam_eng: starting rollback of batch config now. If errors fall post-redis restart we'll keep rollback; otherwise we'll revert fully. Update in ~15m.

marta_cs: I'll ping the ACME CSM with a short heads-up and the mitigation plan. Thanks team. :pray:
